controls: unprivileged user, network, PID, mount namespaces
seccomp syscall denylist including socket and fork
RLIMIT_AS 512 MiB; RLIMIT_CPU 8 seconds; RLIMIT_FSIZE 1 MiB
parent wall-timeout 2-30 sec; process group kill
host environment and credentials not mounted
limitations: cgroup filesystem read-only, so no independent pids/memory/IO cgroups
kernel namespace escape resistance not independently audited
